description: Context Builder page — where users create reusable context configurations that provide background information and instructions to AI during workflow execution

groups.name: Page Purpose
groups.description: The Context Builder allows users to create and manage reusable context configurations. Contexts provide structured background information, domain knowledge, and behavioral instructions that are injected into AI prompts during workflow execution. By defining contexts separately from workflows, users can share common knowledge across multiple workflows without duplication.

assertions.description: Users can create new context configurations that define background knowledge and instructions for AI-driven workflow steps
Users can save contexts to the library and reuse them across multiple workflows, ensuring consistent AI behavior
Users can browse all saved contexts in a searchable list and select any context for editing or review

groups.name: Context Editing Goals
groups.description: Users need to define rich context configurations with names, descriptions, and structured content that will be injected into AI prompts. The editing experience should make it easy to craft precise instructions that guide AI behavior during workflow execution.

assertions.description: Users can set a descriptive name for each context that identifies its purpose when selecting contexts for workflows
Users can write detailed context content including domain knowledge, coding standards, project conventions, and behavioral constraints for the AI
Users can delete contexts that are no longer needed, removing them from the library permanently

groups.name: Workflow Integration Goals
groups.description: The primary value of contexts comes from their integration with workflows. Users create contexts so they can attach them to workflow steps, ensuring the AI has the right background information when executing automation tasks.

assertions.description: Contexts created here can be attached to workflow steps in the Workflow Builder, injecting their content into AI prompts during execution
When a context is updated, all workflows referencing it automatically use the updated content on their next execution

states.name: Context List Browsing
states.description: The default landing state showing the searchable context list in the left panel. The header displays the page title and a New button. No context is selected and the right editor panel is empty or shows an empty-state prompt.

transitions.name: Create new context
transitions.description: User clicks the New button in the header to open a blank editor form for creating a new context

transitions.name: Select existing context
transitions.description: User clicks a context item in the list to load it into the editor panel for viewing or editing

states.name: Creating New Context
states.description: The editor panel displays a blank form for creating a new context. Fields include name, scope selector, content textarea, auto-include toggle, priority input, and tags. The Save button persists the new context to the library. No Delete button is present because the item has not been saved yet.

transitions.name: Save new context
transitions.description: User fills in the form and clicks Save to persist the new context, which then appears in the list and transitions to editing state

transitions.name: Select different context
transitions.description: User abandons the new form by clicking an existing context in the list

states.name: Editing Existing Context
states.description: A context is selected from the list and its data is loaded into the editor panel. The user can modify the name, scope, content, options, and tags. Save persists changes, Delete removes the context. The Delete button distinguishes this state from the creating state.

transitions.name: Save changes
transitions.description: User clicks Save to persist modifications to the selected context

transitions.name: Delete context
transitions.description: User clicks Delete to remove the context, returning to the browse state with no selection

transitions.name: Create new context while editing
transitions.description: User clicks New to start creating a fresh context, replacing the current editor contents

transitions.name: Switch to different context
transitions.description: User clicks a different context in the list to load it into the editor
